entries.title: Job 17:1
segments: My spirit is consumed, my days are extinct, The grave is [ready] for me.

entries.title: Job 17:2
segments: Surely there are mockers with me, And mine eye dwelleth upon their provocation.

entries.title: Job 17:3
segments: Give now a pledge, be surety for me with thyself; Who is there that will strike hands with me?

entries.title: Job 17:4
segments: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: Therefore shalt thou not exalt [them].

entries.title: Job 17:5
segments: He that denounceth his friends for a prey, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.

entries.title: Job 17:6
segments: But he hath made me a byword of the people; And they spit in my face.

entries.title: Job 17:7
segments: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, And all my members are as a shadow.

entries.title: Job 17:8
segments: Upright men shall be astonished at this, And the innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.

entries.title: Job 17:9
segments: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way, And he that hath clean hands shall wax stronger and stronger.

entries.title: Job 17:10
segments: But as for you all, come on now again; And I shall not find a wise man among you.

entries.title: Job 17:11
segments: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.

entries.title: Job 17:12
segments: They change the night into day: The light, [say they], is near unto the darkness.

entries.title: Job 17:13
segments: If I look for Sheol as my house; If I have spread my couch in the darkness;

entries.title: Job 17:14
segments: If I have said to corruption, Thou art my father; To the worm, [Thou art] my mother, and my sister;

entries.title: Job 17:15
segments: Where then is my hope? And as for my hope, who shall see it?

entries.title: Job 17:16
segments: It shall go down to the bars of Sheol, When once there is rest in the dust.
